singleLifecycleState.rule: ONE_BUSINESS_LIFECYCLE_COLUMN_PER_AGGREGATE; technical processing/privacy/delivery states are separate non-business machines

typedCrossOwnerReferences.rule: UUID_PLUS_OWNER_TYPE_PURPOSE_VERSION_AS_OF; NO CROSS_DATABASE FK OR FOREIGN LOCAL ID

recurrenceSafeUniqueness.rule: occurrence_key or typed ordinal participates in uniqueness; legitimate repeat never collides on content/correlation hash

intervalSemantics.rule: HALF_OPEN [from,to); end>start; exclusion where same-owner overlap is invalid; timezone/DST owner normalization required

correlationHashUniquenessRemoval.rule: correlation/digest/content/message/token hashes are nonunique lookup/integrity indexes only
correlationHashUniquenessRemoval.migration: drop legacy hash/correlation unique only after duplicate profiling; add typed identity unique first; validate; forward-correct

directPublicationProof.rule: approval/refetch + canonical digest + immutable/write-once proof + outbox same transaction

compensationSnapshot.proof: refetch approval; recompute ordered digest/count/currency/total; deferred constraint; distinct snapshot/plan/cycle IDs

wfmValidation.engine: owner produces candidate versions and typed shift lines
wfmValidation.validation: owner produces receipt+violation+fairness normalized lines and derived counts
wfmValidation.publish: local validated candidate+approved request+same-owner canonical receipt -> immutable ledger

skillsTaxonomyEvidence.taxonomy: immutable version + nodes + edges + proficiency ordinals with exact composite FKs and application DAG cycle check
skillsTaxonomyEvidence.evidence: typed worker/skill/version/evidence owner refs; RECORDED->VERIFIED->REVOKED CAS

contingentSaga.proof: classification/access messages use inbox+CAS+closed ack+outbox; sponsor history half-open append only

offerOnboardingAnalyticsAiLifecycles.onboarding: template version + recurrence assignment/task revisions/evidence; reduction counts exact
offerOnboardingAnalyticsAiLifecycles.ai: typed DWP governance refs, revision pins, human oversight/disclosure, impact/conformity/incident/rollback/monitoring/expiry/kill switch; G6 fail closed

strictForwardMigration.rule: STRICT CREATE TABLE/INDEX/POLICY/TRIGGER/FUNCTION; Flyway history supplies replay idempotence; pre-created collision fails
strictForwardMigration.schema: existing schema accepted only with exact owner/ACL/role-attribute precondition

acl.apiRuntime: no DELETE; mutable aggregate exact SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only
acl.reader: approved views/projections only; raw/private/comp/AI prompt-result tables zero
